spans.s: --one who has not had tonsure: his death leaves pollution for one night; pollution after चूड is for three nights. M. १८. 3.
(I)--a ब्राह्मन् invited for the राजसूय of युधिष्ठिर to officiate as a priest. भा., X. ७४. 9.

(II)--a पौराणिक. Learnt one of the four मूलसम्हितस् from the disciple of व्यास;
1: भा.,

.
a pupil of Roma- हर्षण; otherwise known as काश्यप.
2: Vi.

(IV)--the Brahman boy rescued by परशु- राम, his guru, from the jaws of a tiger.
1: Br. III. २६. 3; ३०. २१; ३४, 8, २९; ३५. ३७.
Advised to take courage and console his mother; condoled with him on the loss of his parents.
2: Br. III. ३७. १०; ३८, 2, ३५; ३९. १३; ४१. १५, १७; ४३, ३१; ४४. 1, ३०.
Accompanied परशुराम, to Mandira for a twelve years' penance and to Mahendra for another course of austerities. Helped परशुराम in his अश्वमेध and the penance after.
3: Br. III. ४६. 3, २८; ४७. ३४, ५९.
--a son of सम्हताश्व. Br. III. ६३. ६५; M. १२, ३४. [page१-003+ ४६]
